verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents starting a voice or video call from a channel or DM inside the Discord client. Two items come close but do not count. 'HD video streaming' is a Nitro quality perk, an adjacent feature rather than in-app call initiation. Social SDK voice chat is a developer building block for embedding voice in third-party games, not a call button inside Discord.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app
